changes.text: New compact navigation bar — sections are icons, the active one smoothly reveals its name
Light theme + 8 accent colors — pick your look in Settings. The Light theme is now fully white (cards, inputs, navigation) with dark text
Fixed app error when switching theme or accent color
Apply to Roblox button now animates on press — shows Applying... then Applied so you always know it worked
FPS presets — Potato / Balanced / Quality applied with one click
Zapret presets now in a dropdown list instead of cycling
Custom launcher background now survives updates — it is re-downloaded automatically if the cache is lost
Built-in Zapret DPI bypass — one toggle in Settings, so Roblox images, the CDN and Discord keep working on ISPs that block them (RU and similar)
22 DPI bypass presets (general, ALT 1–13, EXP, FAKE TLS AUTO, SIMPLE FAKE) — switch in Settings if your ISP needs another strategy
The bypass runs silently after the first enable and survives launcher restarts
Much stronger FPS optimization — Apply Customization now applies a full performance kit (grass off, MSAA off, low textures, lighting and telemetry optimizations)
Translations improved — all 6 languages (EN/RU/RO/FR/JA/CS) now cover every button, toggle and section
Fixed news photos not loading — direct image links and Discord CDN supported, broken links show a clean placeholder
General stability improvements
Naxi Pro — unlock with a one-time invite code, bound to your PC
PC optimization scan — free FPS forecast for your hardware, Pro applies the best preset in one click
Pro perks showcase with locks on the Pro tab
Multi-use invite codes — one code can now have 3, 5, 50 or more activations
Pro branding — gold logo, Pro icon and Naxi Bootstrap Pro title when Pro is active
Emote wheel customization is now a Pro feature
Per-game flag profiles — each game gets its own preset, captured automatically when you launch it (Pro)
Per-game cursors — assign custom cursors to individual games (Pro)
Pro codes with duration — 1/3/6 months or any number of days, time left is shown in the launcher, premium can be revoked per device
Custom cursors, emote textures and skybox settings now persist across Roblox updates
Added Discord Rich Presence editor with custom details, images and buttons
Added Roblox Studio launch from the Home page
Improved launcher startup, window behavior and localization
General stability and interface improvements
News tab — photo on top, text below, custom font, author chooser (Foxzy/Liniks69/mxxnbyal), NEW tag
News detail — click any post to open full view with smooth fade/slide
Subtitle GAME UPDATE is now editable per post
Photo fades to gray on scroll, rounded top corners
Legal tab updated — anti-steal protection, code obfuscation
Drag window by top bar only
Discord RPC Editor — custom presence (Details/State/Large Image, elapsed time)
Studio button — launch Roblox Studio from Home
Launcher minimizes to tray after launching Roblox
Fixed update system via updatelog.json on GitHub
Fixed Update Log scrolling
Emotes tab — custom emote wheel textures (CircleBackground, SegmentedCircle, SelectedGradient, SelectedLine)
IBeam cursor — custom text input cursor support
Skybox now works with .tex files instead of PNG (select any .tex, all files from that folder applied)
Font changer replaces ALL Roblox fonts (not just Builder Sans) — works in games too
System tray — launcher minimizes to tray on close (double-click to restore, right-click for Show/Exit)
I-beam cursor on text input fields
Fixed Emotes tab preview not showing after restart
Fixed Cursors tab preview not showing after restart
Cursors tab — custom Normal / Pointing / Shift-Lock cursors (PNG import)
Central backup & auto-migration — custom cursors, skybox and fonts survive Roblox updates
Reset to Default now restores embedded default cursors (Arrow, Hand, I-Beam, Shift-Lock)
Fixed Shift-Lock path (content/textures/MouseLockedCursor.png)
Fixed Reset crash (logical child error) and backup handling
Account switching now works correctly
Launch button uses last selected account
Last used account indicator
Stability improvements
Bug fixes

Redesigned buttons and pages
